name: lucky-drop
author: Takaro
description:
Lucky Drop keeps players online with surprise rewards. Every so often (default 45 minutes, plus or minus a random jitter) a random online player wins a lucky drop: a reward rolled from a weighted table with rarities such as Common, Rare and Legendary. A reward can be currency, items, or both. The whole server sees "{player} got a Rare lucky drop: 200 coins!".

Who can win:
- players with the LUCKY_DROP_ELIGIBLE permission
- at least `minSessionMinutes` online this session
- not AFK (position unchanged since the last check), when `excludeAfk` is on
- the drop only happens when at least `minOnlinePlayers` are online
- LUCKY_DROP_VIP_WEIGHT (count) multiplies a player's chance to be picked

Claim race mode: instead of picking a winner, the server announces the drop and the first eligible player to type the `grab` command within 30 s gets it.

Admins use `luckystats` to see the next drop time, totals per rarity and the latest drops, and `luckydropnow` to force a drop.

The `dropTick` cron job checks every 5 minutes whether a drop is due. Items are given with the game's give-item support; currency needs the economy enabled.
summary: Surprise rewards that keep players online. Every ~45 minutes (with random jitter) a random eligible online player wins a lucky drop rolled from a weighted rarity table (Common/Rare/Legendary): currency, items or both, announced to the server. Optional claim race: first player to type grab wins. Min online players, min session time, AFK exclusion, VIP odds via permission count, admin stats.

dropIntervalMinutes.title: Drop interval (minutes)
dropIntervalMinutes.description: Average minutes between lucky drops. The dropTick cron job checks every 5 minutes, so the real timing has 5-minute steps.

jitterMinutes.title: Random jitter (minutes)
jitterMinutes.description: Each drop happens up to this many minutes earlier or later than the interval, so players cannot predict it. 0 = exact interval.

minOnlinePlayers.title: Minimum online players
minOnlinePlayers.description: No drop happens while fewer players are online. The drop fires as soon as enough players are online.

minSessionMinutes.title: Minimum session time (minutes)
minSessionMinutes.description: A player must be online at least this long in the current session to win a random drop. 0 = no minimum. Does not apply to claim races.

excludeAfk.title: Exclude AFK players
excludeAfk.description: Skip players whose position did not change since the previous check (about 5 minutes). Players without position data are never treated as AFK.

mode.title: Drop mode
mode.description: random = pick a random eligible online player. claimRace = announce the drop and the first player to type the grab command wins.

claimWindowSeconds.title: Claim race window (seconds)
claimWindowSeconds.description: How long players have to type the grab command in claim race mode.

rewards.title: Reward table
rewards.description: Weighted reward table. A higher weight makes that rarity more likely. Each entry gives its currency and/or all of its items.

rarity.title: Rarity name
rarity.description: Shown in the announcement, for example Common, Rare or Legendary.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency given. Needs the economy enabled.

dropMessage.title: Drop announcement
dropMessage.description: Broadcast when someone wins a drop. Placeholders: {player}, {rarity}, {reward}.

claimAnnounceMessage.title: Claim race announcement
claimAnnounceMessage.default: A {rarity} lucky drop appeared! Type {prefix}grab within {seconds} s to claim it!
claimAnnounceMessage.description: Broadcast when a claim race starts. Placeholders: {rarity}, {reward}, {prefix}, {seconds}.

claimExpiredMessage.title: Claim race expired message
claimExpiredMessage.default: Nobody grabbed the {rarity} lucky drop in time. Better luck next time!
claimExpiredMessage.description: Broadcast at the next check when nobody grabbed the drop. Placeholders: {rarity}, {reward}. Empty = no message.

historySize.title: History size
historySize.description: How many recent drops luckystats keeps.

permissions.description: Player can win random lucky drops and grab claim-race drops.
Multiplies the chance to be picked for a random drop. Count = multiplier, for example 2 = twice as likely.
Can see lucky drop stats and force a drop.

grab.description: Grab the current claim-race lucky drop.
grab.helpText: Be the first to type this after a lucky drop appears to claim it.

luckystats.description: Admin: show the next drop time, totals per rarity and recent lucky drops.
luckystats.helpText: Shows lucky drop stats and recent winners. Admin only.

luckydropnow.description: Admin: force a lucky drop right now.
luckydropnow.helpText: Forces a lucky drop now in the configured mode. Skips the timer, minimum online players, session time and AFK checks; the eligible permission still counts. Admin only.

on-player-connected.description: Remembers when a player's session started, for the minimum session time.

dropTick.description: Every 5 minutes: track AFK positions, close expired claim races and fire a lucky drop when one is due.
